name: Post photo
description: Create a photo post (1-35 images) on TikTok via Content Posting API. Supports two modes: - MEDIA_UPLOAD: Uploads photos to user's inbox for review/editing before posting - DIRECT_POST: Immediately posts photos to user's TikTok account IMPORTANT: Photo URLs must be from your TikTok-verified domain. Unverified domains will return 403 Forbidden. Unaudited apps can only post with privacy='SELF_ONLY'. Rate limit: 6 requests per minute per user access token. Reference: https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-photo-post

post_mode.title: Post Mode
post_mode.description: Use DIRECT_POST to publish immediately (requires video.publish), or MEDIA_UPLOAD to send to inbox for editing (requires video.upload)

photo_images.title: Photo Images
photo_images.description: List of 1-35 publicly accessible HTTPS image URLs (JPG, JPEG, or WEBP format). IMPORTANT: URLs must be from your TikTok-verified domain or URL prefix. Random/third-party URLs will be rejected with 403 error.

privacy_level.title: PrivacyLevel
privacy_level.description:
Privacy levels accepted by TikTok's Content Posting API.

The valid set for a given account is only discoverable via
``/v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/``. For unaudited apps only
``SELF_ONLY`` is permitted.

https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-direct-post

auto_add_music.title: Auto Add Music
auto_add_music.description: DIRECT_POST only. Auto add recommended music.

disable_comment.title: Disable Comment
disable_comment.description: DIRECT_POST only. Disallow comments if true.

photo_cover_index.title: Photo Cover Index
photo_cover_index.description: Zero-based index (0 to len(photo_images)-1) indicating which image to use as the cover/thumbnail

brand_content_toggle.title: Brand Content Toggle
brand_content_toggle.description: DIRECT_POST only. Set true if content is a paid partnership to promote a third-party business.

brand_organic_toggle.title: Brand Organic Toggle
brand_organic_toggle.description: DIRECT_POST only. Set true if content promotes the creator's own business.

PostPhotoResponse.title: PostPhotoResponse

data.title: Data
data.description: Contains the success response information for the photo post request. Present on success with publish_id.

error.title: Error
error.description: Contains error details and status information for the API request. Always present with code='ok' on success or error code on failure.

PostPhotoResponse.description:
Response from TikTok photo post API.

On success, data.publish_id is populated and error.code is 'ok'.
On failure, error.code contains error type and error.message has details.

PostPhotoDataResponse.title: PostPhotoDataResponse

publish_id.title: Publish Id
publish_id.description: A unique identifier to track the posting action, which can be used to check the status of the photo post. Maximum length: 64 characters. Present on success.

PostPhotoDataResponse.description: Contains the success response information for the photo post request.

PostPhotoErrorResponse.title: PostPhotoErrorResponse

code.title: Code
code.description: Status indicator code. Returns 'ok' on success, other values indicate failure (e.g., 'invalid_param', 'access_token_invalid', 'rate_limit_exceeded', 'scope_not_authorized').

log_id.title: Log Id
log_id.description: Unique execution identifier for request tracking and debugging purposes.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable error description. Empty string when the request is successful.

PostPhotoErrorResponse.description: Contains error details and status information for the API request.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
